name: Hames Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Monterey Chardonnay is associated with mango and guava.
In the late 20th century its Cabernet Sauvignon was known for very vegetal, green pepper flavors.

blurb.text: A small east to west valley in southern Monterey County, near the San Luis Obispo County line, west of the Salinas River.
